annotations.title: Check whether ProofSnap issued a manifest

description: Looks up the SHA-256 of an evidence package's manifest.json in ProofSnap's public ledger: whether ProofSnap issued exactly this manifest, and when. It covers packages issued by the ProofSnap API and dashboard; packages made with the browser extension are not in this ledger. Returns issued (true or false) and, when issued, issued_at, the package type and eidas (whether the package carries an eIDAS qualified timestamp). Reads public ledger data only; no account is needed.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the package's manifest.json as 64 hexadecimal characters (a sha256: prefix is accepted), for example the manifest_hash of a capture

name: lookup_manifest
title: Check whether ProofSnap issued a manifest
